# Third-Party Art Credits

The following assets are used under their recorded licenses. CC0 attribution
is retained for provenance; CC-BY attribution is required.

- **大肥鱼 打工版 / 上班鱼** by 木子恶魔, https://www.bilibili.com/.
  The project owner confirmed the author's written permission for non-video
  uses. Source provenance is recorded in
  `Assets/Demo02/Art/Characters/AnimeFishPilot/SOURCE.md`.
- **Fantasy Town Kit** by Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets/fantasy-town-kit,
  CC0 1.0. Selected models were imported unchanged; project materials and
  prefabs are stored under `Assets/Demo02/Art`.
- **Blocky Characters** by Kenney,
  https://kenney.nl/assets/blocky-characters, CC0 1.0. Six animated Humanoid
  characters were imported unchanged; project materials, controller and
  prefabs are stored under `Assets/Demo02/Art/Characters/Blocky`.
- **Animated Characters Protagonists** by Kenney,
  https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-protagonists, CC0 1.0. One
  model, four skins, and idle/run/jump animations are used for the default
  character visuals. Project materials and prefabs are stored under
  `Assets/Demo02/Art/Characters/Stylized`.
- **City Kit Commercial** by Kenney,
  https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial, CC0 1.0. Twelve complete
  buildings are normalized for the existing street footprints. Project
  materials and prefabs are stored under `Assets/Demo02/Art/Environment/CityKit`.
- **Medieval Village MegaKit** by Quaternius,
  https://quaternius.com/packs/medievalvillage.html, CC0 1.0. Selected wall,
  roof, corner, balcony, overhang, door, and prop modules are imported from
  the standard free glTF distribution. The playable streets use three
  ready-made shell variants, with each street baked into a small set of
  material batches for runtime performance.
- **Universal Animation Library** by Quaternius,
  https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library, CC0 1.0. The
  standard free glTF set is used for sword attack, hit, interaction, pickup
  and death motion. Five clips are offline-retargeted at build time from the
  source Rigify skeleton to the project's Generic Kenney skeleton.
- **Interface Sounds**, **Impact Sounds** and **RPG Audio** by Kenney,
  https://kenney.nl, CC0 1.0. Selected UI, concrete footstep, impact,
  book-page and weapon-handling sounds are imported as ready-made assets.
- **Grey Plaster 02** by Rob Tuytel, https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_plaster_02,
  CC0 1.0. Imported as a 2K PBR material; Unity mask data is generated from
  the supplied ARM map.
- **Old Planks 02** by Rob Tuytel, https://polyhaven.com/a/old_planks_02,
  CC0 1.0. Imported as a 2K PBR material; Unity mask data is generated from
  the supplied ARM map.
- **Clay Roof Tiles 02** by Amal Kumar,
  https://polyhaven.com/a/clay_roof_tiles_02, CC0 1.0. Imported as a 2K PBR
  material; Unity mask data is generated from the supplied ARM map.
- **Cobblestone 05** by Rob Tuytel,
  https://polyhaven.com/a/cobblestone_05, CC0 1.0. Imported as a 2K PBR
  material; Unity mask data is generated from the supplied ARM map.
- **Grey Roof Tiles 02** by Rob Tuytel,
  https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_roof_tiles_02, CC0 1.0. Imported as a 2K PBR
  material; Unity mask data is generated from the supplied ARM map.
- **Chinese Screen Panels**, **Chinese Armchair**, **Chinese Tea Table** and
  **Chinese Cabinet** by Kirill Sannikov, https://polyhaven.com,
  CC0 1.0. Downloaded as 1K glTF sets and used for the teahouse and warehouse
  interior without mesh edits.
- **Liyan** by elerya, https://opengameart.org/content/liyan,
  CC-BY 3.0. Used as looping exploration music. Attribution must remain in
  the game credits and portfolio materials.
- **鹿鸣同款凉亭** by 泡面fly. The project owner confirmed permission for
  project use. The original Blender package is retained under
  `SourceAssets/References/Downloads/Approved/Environment/`; the optimized
  Unity GLB and processing notes are stored under
  `Assets/Demo02/Art/Environment/Downloaded/Pavilion/`.
- **林间小屋** by HK416单推人. The project owner confirmed permission for
  project use. Five existing billboard trees are composed into the distant
  Dongguan street tree line; the source package remains under
  `SourceAssets/References/Downloads/Approved/Environment/`.
